justifications.goal_fidelity: the node does exactly the plan's second-node acts: the accessor, the shipped default and its reckon-owned key-table entry are deleted and the tests that read the window replaced by a refusal test; every done-when condition was independently reproduced (grep empty, gate green, public_definitions one below base) and the change threshold beside it still resolves.
justifications.reuse: the change deletes an accessor, a default and a redundant whole test file rather than adding a mechanism, introduces no definition that re-implements an existing one, and reuses validate_layer and plan_review_change_threshold for the new coverage.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path lies inside the run's declared six write paths and the evidence fragment directory; no shared index, sprint state or other plan was touched; a one-line cosmetic cleanup of a monkeypatch rebind inside an already-edited test file stays within scope.
